name: SolutionsPRO Store Open Hours
author: miha.jirov

sections.description:
SolutionsPRO Store Open Hours lets WooCommerce store owners define business hours for each day of the week. When the store is closed, the plugin can show a customizable popup and prevent customers from submitting checkout orders.

Features:

  • Separate schedule for each day of the week.
  • Overnight schedules such as 18:00–02:00.
  • Uses the timezone configured in WordPress.
  • Responsive off-hours popup.
  • Optional background image from the WordPress media library.
  • Editable badge, title, message, and button text.
  • Text, accent, and overlay colors through the WordPress Color Picker.
  • Adjustable overlay opacity.
  • Configurable popup repeat interval.
  • Blocks the cart checkout button outside business hours.
  • Blocks the Place Order button on checkout.
  • Server-side checkout validation to prevent order submission while closed.
  • Editable closed-hours notice.
  • Translation-ready and includes several bundled translations.

The plugin does not send store or visitor data to external services and does not include tracking code.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload and activate SolutionsPRO Store Open Hours.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Store Open Hours.
  4. Configure the weekly schedule, popup text, appearance, and checkout messages.
  5. Save the settings.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce is declared as a required plugin dependency.

Which timezone is used?

The plugin uses the timezone configured under Settings > General in WordPress.

Are overnight opening hours supported?

Yes. For example, a schedule from 18:00 to 02:00 remains open after midnight until 02:00 the following day.

Does the plugin send data to third-party services?

No. The plugin does not make external API requests and does not include analytics or tracking.

What happens to the settings when the plugin is deleted?

The plugin removes its saved settings when it is deleted through WordPress.
sections.changelog:
1.0.4

  • Fixed a fatal error on PHP 7.4: replaced DateTimeImmutable::createFromInterface() (PHP 8.0+) in the overnight schedule check.
  • Front-end popup assets are now loaded only while the store is closed.
  • Removed the Plugin URI header that pointed to a page that does not exist yet.

1.0.3

  • Prepared the plugin for WordPress.org submission.
  • Matched the text domain and translation filenames to the plugin slug.
  • Removed hardcoded non-English strings from the admin JavaScript.
  • Added explicit GPL license headers and repository metadata.
  • Improved settings sanitization and permissions handling.

1.0.2

  • Improved localization and default texts.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
